description: Deterministic mobile wireframes from a MAIAS file: one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, no JS, no external URLs) with one phone frame per screen, flows as rows, and click-through anchors between frames. Pass out to write the file (recommended — returns a summary); without out the raw HTML is returned as text (large). Refuses documents with validation errors (dangling targets become dead links) unless force is set.

accent.description: Hex accent colour (e.g. #0A84FF) replacing the default wireframe grey

out.description: Write the HTML here (e.g. <app>-wireframes.html); when absent the HTML is returned as text

states.description: Also emit declared empty/loading/error variants as extra frames

name: wireframe
title: Render an HTML wireframe board
